name: Alveo Vera
description: Alveo Veras consume Carbon Dioxide and Ice, and form harvestable Oxylite deposits.

name: Arbor Tree
description: Arbor Trees grow Arbor Tree Branches and can be harvested for Wood.

name: Balm Lily
description: Balm Lilies produce Balm Lily Flower, a lovely bloom with medicinal properties.

name: Bliss Burst
description: Bliss Bursts release an explosion of Decor into otherwise dull environments.

name: Bluff Briar
description: Bluff Briars exude pheromones causing critters to view them as especially beautiful.

name: Bog Bucket
description: Bog Buckets produce juicy, sweet Bog Jellies for Food.

name: Bonbon Tree
description:
Bonbon Tree branches synthesize Light to produce Nectar.

Branches can be harvested for Wood.

Bonbon Trees can shed most environmental debris, and rarely become entombed.

name: Bristle Blossom
description: Bristle Blossoms produce Bristle Berry, a prickly edible bud.

name: Buddy Bud
description: Buddy Buds are leafy plants that have a positive effect on Morale, much like a friend.

name: Bulbloom
description: Bulblooms emit a bioluminescent Light that enhances Decor.

name: Buried Muckroot
description: Muckroots are incapable of propagating but can be harvested for a single Food serving.

name: Clampum
description:
Clampums are aquatic bivalves that transform Sand into Pearl.

Due to their size, they can only be planted in a Wide Hydroponic Farm.

name: Dasha Saltvine
description: Dasha Saltvines consume small amounts of Chlorine Gas and form sodium deposits as they grow, producing harvestable Salt.

name: Dew Dripper
description: Dew Drippers produce Dewdrips that can be crushed into Brackene.

name: Dusk Cap
description: Dusk Caps produce Mushrooms, fungal growths that can be harvested for Food.

name: Experiment 52B
description:
A Sap-producing cybernetic tree that shows signs of sentience.

It is rooted firmly in place, and is waiting for some brave soul to bring it food.

name: Flue Coral
description:
Flue Corals are aquatic organisms that use Light to produce Oxygen.

Due to their size, they can only be planted in a Wide Hydroponic Farm.

name: Gas Grass
description:
Gas Grass is an alien lifeform tentatively categorized as a "plant."

It can be harvested for Plant Husk or eaten as-is by Moos.

name: Grubfruit Plant
description:
A Grubfruit Plant that has flourished after being tended by a Divergent critter.

It will produce high quality Grubfruits.

name: Gum Palm
description:
Gum Palms can be harvested for Gum Wood, which can be processed into Latex at the Plant Pulverizer.

Due to their size, they can only be planted in a Wide Hydroponic Farm.

name: Hexalent
description: Hexalents are incapable of propagating but can be harvested for a single, calorie dense Food serving.

name: Husha Cups
description:
Husha Cups are Decorative Plants with a temper-cooling blue hue.

Their presence provides a Morale-boosting "cup half-full" energy.

name: Hydrocactus
description: Hydrocacti act as natural Water filters when given access to Sand.

name: Idylla Flower
description:
Idyllas are Decorative Plants with soft, pompom-shaped blossoms.

Gazing dreamily at them has a positive effect on Morale.

name: Jumping Joya
description: Joyas are Decorative Plants that are colloquially said to make gardeners "jump for joy".

name: Lura Plant
description:
Lura plants are carnivorous plants that trap flying critters, such as Gnits.

Their digestive processes produce harvestable Amber.

name: Mealwood
description: Mealwoods produce Meal Lice, an oddly wriggly grain that can be harvested for Food.

name: Megafrond
description: Megafronds produce Megafrond Grain, an ancient grain that can be processed into Food.

name: Mellow Mallow
description: Mellow Mallows heighten Decor and alleviate Stress with their calming color and cradle shape.

name: Mimika Bud
description:
Mimika Buds are self-harvesting plants that produce airborne Mimikas.

Mimikas boost growth for nearby Plants before hardening into Mimillet.

name: Mirth Leaf
description: Mirth Leaves sport a calm green hue known for alleviating Stress and improving Morale.

name: Mussel Sprout
description: Mussel Sprouts are incapable of propagating but can be harvested for a single low quality Food serving.

name: Nosh Sprout
description: Nosh Sprouts thrive in colder climates and produce edible Nosh Beans.

name: Ovagro Node
description:
Ovagro Nodes are trellis plants that spread onto nearby available surfaces.

A single Ovagro Node can support several Ovagro Vines without any increase in its Water requirements.

name: Ovagro Vine
description:
Ovagro Vines are plants that produce edible Ovagro Fig.

If a vine is cut off from its Ovagro Node, it will perish.

name: Oxyfern
description: Oxyferns absorb Carbon Dioxide Gas and exude breathable Oxygen.

name: Petta Pouf
description:
Petta Poufs are Decorative aquatic Plants.

The gentle touch of their blooms soothes passing Duplicants' nerves.

name: Pikeapple Bush
description: Pikeapple bushes produce Pikeapple, a useful yet almost unbearably fragrant Food.

name: Pincha Pepperplant
description: Pincha Pepperplants produce flavorful Pincha Peppernut for spicing Food.

name: Pinpoket
description: Pinpokets produce Pinpoki, which can be processed into Uni or Diamond.

name: Plume Squash Plant
description: Plume Squashes are sweet, nutrient-rich tubers that can be harvested for Food.

name: Ring Rosebush
description: Ring Rosebushes are Decorative Plants that add a touch of whimsy wherever they are planted.

name: Saturn Critter Trap
description: Critter Traps are carnivorous plants that consume small-to-medium-sized critters and release Hydrogen Gas as waste.

name: Seakomb
description:
Seakombs consume Polluted Dirt.

Their leaves can be processed to extract Phyto Oil.

name: Sherberry Plant
description: Sherberries are incapable of propagating, but can be harvested for a single Food serving.

name: Sleet Wheat
description: Sleet Wheat produces Sleet Wheat Grain, a chilly grain that can be processed into Food.

name: Snactus
description: Snacti are incapable of propagating but can be harvested for a single Food serving.

name: Sodicane
description: Sodicane produces Salty Sticks, a sodium-rich Food that leaves Duplicants feeling quite parched.

name: Spindly Grubfruit Plant
description:
Spindly Grubfruit Plants produce Spindly Grubfruit for Food.

If it is tended by a Divergent critter, it will produce high quality fruits instead.

name: Sporechid
description: Sporechids have an eerily alluring appearance to mask the fact that they host particularly nasty strain of brain fungus.

name: Starnacle
description:
Starnacles are aquatic organisms that consume Coquina.

 Its Phosphorite build-up can be consumed by Beakons or harvested by Duplicants.

name: Swamp Chard
description: Swamp Chards are incapable of propagating but can be harvested for a single low quality and calorie dense Food serving.

name: Sweatcorn Stalk
description: Sweatcorn Stalks produce Sweatcorn, a crisp vegetable that can be harvested for Food.

name: Thimble Reed
description: Thimble Reeds produce indescribably soft Reed Fiber for Clothing production.

name: Tower Kelp
description:
Tower Kelp is an aquatic plant that grows in temperate pools.

It can be harvested for Nori.

name: Tranquil Toes
description: Tranquil Toes improve Decor by giving their surroundings the visual equivalent of a foot rub.

name: Tublia
description:
Tublias are aquatic organisms that sprout in Hot liquid environments.

They can be harvested for Plastic.

name: Waterweed
description: Waterweeds thrive in liquid environments and can be harvested for fresh, edible Lettuce.

name: Wheezewort
description: Wheezeworts can be planted in Planter Boxes, Farm Tiles or Hydroponic Farms, and absorb Heat by respiring through their porous outer membranes.
